_comment: The 12 arrows of docs/08-arrows.md §8.3, authored verbatim.
baseMult is the arrow.baseMult term in docs/08 §8.1's master damage
formula. craftCost is docs/08 §8.4's table by content tier: T1 free/800g,
elementPotency's meaning depends on element (docs/08 §8.2): for Ember it
is an application chance (0-1); for Frost it is Chill per hit; for Storm
it is which arrow in sequence triggers a chain (a count, not a fraction);
for Toxin it is stacks per hit.

arrows.name: Ash Shaft
arrows.description: The reference arrow. Perfectly average, no drawback.
arrows.balanceNote: Exists so every other arrow can be described as a trade against it.

arrows.name: Broadhead
arrows.description: Slower, heavier. Far better against plated enemies since single hits clear the Tier-II threshold sooner.
arrows.balanceNote: The anti-Husk pick. Weak with Kestrel (fire rate anti-synergy) by design.

arrows.name: Splitshaft
arrows.description: Fires 2 arrows at ±8°. Two Windlines per shot — the cheapest entry into Confluence play.
arrows.balanceNote: 1.44x total damage but requires both arrows to connect; a downgrade at range against single targets. Intentionally spikes with Iris.

arrows.name: Emberhead
arrows.description: Carries Ember, 35 % application chance per hit.

arrows.name: Blightbarb
arrows.description: Carries Toxin, 1 stack per hit, max 12.
arrows.balanceNote: All four elementals sit at 0.84-0.92 baseMult — an 8-16 % raw damage tax paid for the rider. They out-damage Ash Shaft from roughly chapter 5 onward, exactly when they unlock.

arrows.name: Skimmer
arrows.description: Ricochets 2x off walls or enemies. The highest lattice-generation arrow in the game.

arrows.name: Lancehead
arrows.balanceNote: The Vane/Bram line-clear arrow; poor against dispersed enemies.

arrows.name: Twinfang
arrows.description: Fires 2 arrows on converging paths that cross at 6 u — a guaranteed Confluence every shot.
arrows.balanceNote: docs/08 §8.5 rule 4: grants x1 Confluence reliably; manual play reaches x3 (x5 with Iris). The training-wheels arrow must never beat the mastery it trains.

arrows.name: Ghostshaft
arrows.description: Passes through walls and shields; ignores plating entirely. No pierce, 8 u range.
arrows.balanceNote: Trivialises Husk/Bulwark/Gaunt, compensated by no pierce and a short range. docs/08 §8.5 rule 3: the range cap is load-bearing — if it proves universally correct, the range drops before the damage is touched.

arrows.name: Prismshaft
arrows.description: Cycles all four elements, one per shot.
arrows.balanceNote: The reaction-engine arrow. Weakest raw damage of the T4s; highest ceiling with Confluence. Requires Prismcore x12 to craft, the single largest material cost in the game.
